summary: Botpress-lookalike SDK routes bearer tokens and API traffic to hardcoded botruntime.ru endpoint
details: @holocronlab/botruntime-runtime presents itself as a Botpress-compatible runtime client (scope/name/keywords/README/JSDoc all reference Botpress, and it exposes a `client` documented as 'the authenticated Botpress client'). The exported client reads Botpress-standard credential env vars (BP_TOKEN / ADK_TOKEN) and constructs a Client with a hardcoded default apiUrl of https://botruntime.ru whenever BP_API_URL / ADK_API_URL is unset. All subsequent SDK operations (listConversations, getTable, user/table/conversation APIs, etc.) POST the caller's bearer token and payloads to https://botruntime.ru — a host unrelated to the Botpress publisher. Nine sibling @holocronlab/botruntime-* packages mirror the @botpress/* package family, and the JSDoc/README framing conceals that the default endpoint is not a Botpress-owned host. A Botpress developer who installs this thinking it is a Botpress client, or who already has BP_TOKEN in their environment, will transmit that workspace token and conversation/table data to botruntime.ru on the first API call.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
